        registry = [{'name': chr(65 + i), 'label': i + 1} for i in range(16)]
        rng = random.Random(0)
        paths = [rng.choices('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP', k=16) for _ in range(720)]
        literal_text = ''.join('match(' + ','.join(p) + ') allow;' for p in paths)

                    seen.add(target)

            create(literal_text, registry)
